quarterly_data.signal: Palo Alto Networks 10-K (fiscal 2026, GAAP): total revenue $11,480 million, up 24% (product $2,280 million; subscription $6,239 million; support $2,961 million); gross margin 70.4%; operating margin 6.1%; net income $307 million. RPO $21.2 billion, of which approximately $9.3 billion is expected over the next 12 months. Two distributors each represented 15% of fiscal 2026 revenue (no end-customer above 10%). All of its hardware products are assembled in the U.S. by its EMS provider Flex. Non-cancelable purchase commitments total $8,242 million, including $7,686 million for cloud hosting services and $370 million for manufacturing; Q4 fiscal 2026 supply chain disruption and inflation raised memory and other component costs.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue $11,480 million (+24%); GAAP gross margin 70.4%; cloud commitments $7,686 million; two distributors 15% each
